pkgmetadata.longdescription:
This is an experimental ebuild for the executable portion of some scripts for running and interacting with network namespaces. The namespaces need to be set up seperately with any daemons running inside them, though this ebuild will install some basic prerequisites.
It assumes you are using openvpn for the "vpn" network namespace. This should be changed in the future to a) handle different types of VPNs, b) allow for easier adding/subtracting of namespaces.
The namespace setup and starting their daemons is not currently automated.

use.flag: Install net-vpn/tor for the netns-tor namespace
